versos.grego: Καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ Σαδδουκαῖοι πειράζοντες ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν σημεῖον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
controles.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
controles.livre: Então os fariseus e os saduceus se aproximaram dele e, a fim de tentá-lo, pediram-lhe que lhes mostrasse algum sinal do céu.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὀψίας γενομένης λέγετε Εὐδία, πυρράζει γὰρ ὁ οὐρανός·

controles.web: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’
controles.kjv: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
controles.livre: Mas ele lhes respondeu:  Quando chega a tarde, dizeis: “ Haverá tempo bom, pois o céu está vermelho”.

versos.grego: καὶ πρωΐ Σήμερον χειμών, πυρράζει γὰρ στυγνάζων ὁ οὐρανός. τὸ μὲν πρόσωπον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γινώσκετε διακρίνειν, τὰ δὲ σημεῖα τῶν καιρῶν οὐ δύνασθε;

controles.web: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!
controles.kjv: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
controles.livre: E pela manhã: “Hoje haverá tempestade, pois o céu está de um vermelho sombrio”. Vós bem sabeis distinguir a aparência do céu, mas os sinais dos tempos não podeis?

versos.grego: γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ. καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἀπῆλθεν.

controles.web: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.”   He left them, and departed.
controles.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
controles.livre: Uma geração má e adúltera pede um sinal; mas nenhum sinal lhe será dado, a não ser o sinal de Jonas.Então os deixou, e foi embora

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἰς τὸ πέραν ἐπελάθοντο ἄρτους λαβεῖν.

controles.web: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.
controles.kjv: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
controles.livre: E quando os discípulos vieram para a outra margem, esqueceram-se de tomar pão.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὁρᾶτε καὶ προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
controles.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes disse: Ficai atentos, e tende cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e saduceus.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες ὅτι Ἄρτους οὐκ ἐλάβομεν.

controles.web: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
controles.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
controles.livre: E eles argumentaram entre si, dizendo: É porque não tomamos pão.

versos.grego: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τί διαλογίζεσθε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, ὀλιγόπιστοι, ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ἔχετε;

controles.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, ‘because you have brought no bread?’
controles.kjv: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
controles.livre: Jesus percebeu, e disse: Por que estais argumentando entre vós mesmos, ó homens de pouca fé, que não tendes pão?

versos.grego: οὔπω νοεῖτε, οὐδὲ μνημονεύετε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους τῶν πεντακισχιλίων καὶ πόσους κοφίνους ἐλάβετε;

controles.web: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
controles.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
controles.livre: Ainda não entendeis, nem vos lembrais dos cinco pães dos cinco mil, e quantos cestos levantastes?

versos.grego: οὐδὲ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους τῶν τετρακισχιλίων καὶ πόσας σπυρίδας ἐλάβετε;

controles.web: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
controles.kjv: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
controles.livre: Nem dos sete pães dos quatro mil, e quantos cestos levantastes?

versos.grego: πῶς οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι οὐ περὶ ἄρτων εἶπον ὑμῖν; προσέχετε δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

controles.web: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
controles.kjv: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
controles.livre: Como não entendeis que não foi pelo pão que eu vos disse? Mas tomai cuidado com o fermento dos fariseus e saduceus.

versos.grego: τότε συνῆκαν ὅτι οὐκ εἶπεν προσέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν ἄρτων, ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τῆς διδαχῆς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.

controles.web: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
controles.kjv: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
controles.livre: Então entenderam que ele não havia dito que tomassem cuidado com o fermento dos pães, mas sim com a doutrina dos fariseus e saduceus.

versos.grego: Ἐλθὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὰ μέρη Καισαρίας τῆς Φιλίππου ἠρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων Τίνα λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;

controles.web: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
controles.kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
controles.livre: E tendo Jesus vindo às partes da Cesareia de Filipe, perguntou aos seus discípulos: Quem as pessoas dizem que o Filho do homem é?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Οἱ μὲν Ἰωάνην τὸν Βαπτιστήν, ἄλλοι δὲ Ἡλείαν, ἕτεροι δὲ Ἱερεμίαν ἢ ἕνα τῶν προφητῶν.

controles.web: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”
controles.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
controles.livre: E eles responderam: Alguns João Batista, outros Elias, e outros Jeremias ou algum dos profetas.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι;

controles.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”
controles.kjv: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
controles.livre: Ele lhes disse: E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος εἶπεν Σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος.

controles.web: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
controles.kjv: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
controles.livre: E Simão Pedro respondeu: Tu és o Cristo, o Filho do Deus vivo!

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μακάριος εἶ, Σίμων Βαριωνᾶ, ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα οὐκ ἀπεκάλυψέν σοι ἀλλ’ ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar–jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe replicou: Bendito  és tu, Simão, filho de Jonas;  pois não foi carne e sangue que o revelou a ti, mas sim meu Pai, que está nos céus.

versos.grego: κἀγὼ δέ σοι λέγω ὅτι σὺ εἶ Πέτρος, καὶ ἐπὶ ταύτῃ τῇ πέτρᾳ οἰκοδομήσω μου τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, καὶ πύλαι Ἅιδου οὐ κατισχύσουσιν αὐτῆς.

controles.web: I also tell you that you are Peter,and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hadeswill not prevail against it.
controles.kjv: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
controles.livre: E eu também te digo que tu és Pedro, e sobre esta pedra edificarei a minha igreja; e as portas do mundo dos mortos não prevalecerão contra ela.

versos.grego: δώσω σοι τὰς κλεῖδας τῆς βασιλείας τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν δήσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν λύσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”
controles.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
controles.livre: A ti darei as chaves do Reino dos céus; e tudo o que ligares na terra terá sido ligado  nos céus; e tudo o que desligares na terra terá sido desligado  nos céus.

versos.grego: τότε ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ εἴπωσιν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός.

controles.web: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.
controles.kjv: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
controles.livre: Então mandou aos discípulos que a ninguém dissessem que ele era o Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς δεικνύειν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἀπελθεῖν καὶ πολλὰ παθεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι.

controles.web: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.
controles.kjv: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
controles.livre: Desde então Jesus Cristo começou a mostrar a seus discípulos que ele tinha que ir a Jerusalém, e sofrer muito pelos anciãos, pelos chefes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas, e ser morto, e ser ressuscitado ao terceiro dia.

versos.grego: καὶ προσλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ὁ Πέτρος ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ λέγων Ἵλεώς σοι, Κύριε· οὐ μὴ ἔσται σοι τοῦτο.

controles.web: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”
controles.kjv: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
controles.livre: E Pedro o tomou à parte, e começou a repreendê-lo, dizendo: Misericórdia de ti, Senhor! De maneira nenhuma isso te aconteça.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ στραφεὶς εἶπεν τῷ Πέτρῳ Ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ· σκάνδαλον εἶ ἐμοῦ, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: But he turned, and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”
controles.kjv: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
controles.livre: Mas ele se virou, e disse a Pedro: Para trás de mim, Satanás! Tu és um obstáculo, porque não compreendes as coisas de Deus, mas sim as humanas.

versos.grego: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

controles.web: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
controles.livre: Então Jesus disse a seus discípulos: Se alguém quiser vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, tome sobre si a sua cruz, e siga-me.

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν· ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ, εὑρήσει αὐτήν.

controles.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.
controles.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
controles.livre: Pois qualquer um que quiser salvar a sua vida a perderá; porém qualquer um que por causa de mim perder a sua vida, este a achará.

versos.grego: τί γὰρ ὠφεληθήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον κερδήσῃ, τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ζημιωθῇ; ἢ τί δώσει ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
controles.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
controles.livre: Pois que proveito haverá para alguém, se ganhar o mundo todo, mas perder a sua alma? Ou que dará alguém em resgate da sua alma?

versos.grego: μέλλει γὰρ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ Πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ, καὶ τότε ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν πρᾶξιν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.
controles.kjv: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
controles.livre: Pois o Filho do homem virá na glória do seu Pai com os seus anjos, e então recompensará a cada um segundo as suas obras.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες τῶν ὧδε ἑστώτων οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que há alguns, dos que aqui estão, que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o Filho do homem vir em seu Reino.
